description: The Ministry of Health requires a standardized color scheme for the 'Institutional delivery rate' indicator. Navigate to the Maintenance app and create a new Legend Set named 'RMNCH Standard Scorecard'. Configure three legend items: 'Critical' (0-50, Red), 'Warning' (50-80, Yellow/Orange), and 'Good' (80-100, Green). Finally, find the 'Institutional delivery rate' indicator and assign this newly created Legend Set to it. Ensure you save your changes.
